messages.subject: Project Lyra — first draft Patent and Know-How Licence
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver,

Attached is our first full draft of the Patent and Know-How Licence for HRX-218 (v1, clean). Key points to flag: exclusive worldwide grant in the oncology field; the agreed milestone and royalty architecture; and clause 11 drafted with the IP warranties, the grant and confidentiality outside any cap. We've left diligence at Commercially Reasonable Efforts without a hard long-stop for now.

Look forward to your mark-up in the new year.

James

--
James Osei | Senior Associate, Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
